reproduction.rationale: Both paper_data and paper_data_author_code must preserve the same full original ALM DR/WC/fixed/randomized scientific identities, authentic inputs and budgets, with official author code the only information addition. Authentic original cohort/trial/time/metric manifests and granular output verification are absent; historical rank/threshold privileges, source repairs and target exposure are not automatically code-only additions. Reproduction additionally needs full source-native findings/control references and justified tolerances/uncertainty; printed numbers or the accepted evaluator on invented operands cannot populate either AI condition.
